# 🗓️ Brisbane Events Digest: 11–17 May 2026

Here's your curated weekly guide — filtered for intellectual curiosity, creative energy, community, and live culture. Events are sorted by date.

---

## 🎭 ONGOING FESTIVALS (All Week)

---

### 1. 🎭 Brisbane Comedy Festival 2026
**Dates:** Running all week (Fri 24 Apr – Sun 25 May 2026)
**Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse (New Farm), The Tivoli, Princess Theatre, Fortitude Music Hall
**Cost:** Tickets vary by show
**Category:** Concert / Music / Live Performance
**Source:** Must Do Brisbane / Eventbrite
**Ticket Link:** https://www.mustdobrisbane.com/whats-on/brisbane-comedy-festival-2026

Brisbane Comedy Festival is back with a packed line-up of festival favourites and fresh new faces, running from April 24 to May 24. Now in its 17th edition, the festival takes over Brisbane Powerhouse, The Tivoli, Fortitude Music Hall and The Princess Theatre for its biggest season yet. Specific shows this week to note:

- **Claire Hooper – "fun show xx"** (Brisbane Powerhouse, 14–17 May): Claire just wants to have fun — but she's the least fun person she knows, so she's got her work cut out. This is going to involve time, energy, sweat and tears, and probably some lists.
- **Pete Helliar** (Princess Theatre, 16 & 17 May): What happens when a well-meaning comedian makes a cheeky joke about ISIS during a live interview on national TV? A full-blown international incident. In this hilariously outrageous true story, Pete Helliar finds himself at the centre of a media firestorm — a wild, hilarious deep dive into intent, outrage, and the terrifying power of one well-timed punchline.

---

### 2. 🎪 Anywhere Festival 2026
**Dates:** Running all week (Fri 1 May – Sun 31 May 2026)
**Venue:** Across Brisbane — from New Farm and West End to Mt Coot-tha planetarium and beyond
**Cost:** Free–low cost (most shows under $30)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Community
**Source:** Must Do Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.mustdobrisbane.com/whats-on/brisbane-anywhere-festival-2026

From strip clubs to electricity substations, warehouses to houses, libraries to galleries, wine cellars to laneways, botanic gardens and the planetarium — anywhere in Brisbane becomes the stage in this 16th annual festival, with just under 300 performances. Anywhere Festival locations this year include Albion, Yeronga, Grange, Milton, Brisbane City, West End, Salisbury, Mt Coot-tha, The Gap, New Farm, Northshore, Kelvin Grove, Fortitude Valley, Wooloowin, Chelmer, South Brisbane, and more. Check the full program for shows scheduled this specific week at anywherefestival.com.au.

---

### 3. 🩰 Circa – Swan Lake (QPAC)
**Dates:** 13–16 May 2026
**Venue:** QPAC, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed (prices vary)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Live Performance
**Source:** Must Do Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.mustdobrisbane.com/whats-on

Feathers will fly as Circa returns to QPAC with their exuberant take on Swan Lake, the world's most romantic ballet. Circa's ever-impressive ensemble combines Swan Lake and The Ugly Duckling, featuring a burlesque-style black swan and a cute parade of waddling (human) ducks — expect acrobatics, circus arts, and live music in one of Brisbane's most inventive companies' signature productions.

---

### 4. 🎭 The Drover's Wife – The Opera (World Premiere, QPAC)
**Dates:** Running this week (opens May 2026)
**Venue:** Glasshouse Theatre, QPAC, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Live Performance
**Source:** Must Do Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.mustdobrisbane.com/whats-on

The Drover's Wife – The Opera will have its world premiere in QPAC's stunning new Glasshouse Theatre. Based on the iconic Australian story and Henry Lawson's short story, this world premiere opera is a rare chance to witness Brisbane as the birthplace of a brand new major work.

---

### 5. 🖼️ The Sapphires (Bille Brown Theatre)
**Dates:** Running this week (28 Apr – 24 May 2026)
**Venue:** Bille Brown Theatre, Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Source:** Broadsheet Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.broadsheet.com.au/brisbane/entertainment/article/brisbane-theatre-musicals-2026

The Sapphires runs from April 28 to May 24 at Bille Brown Theatre. Tickets are available online. The beloved story of four Aboriginal women singing soul music for troops in Vietnam — joyful, moving, and musically rich.

### 6. 🖼️ Olafur Eliasson: Presence (QAGOMA)
**Dates:** Ongoing (running this week)
**Venue:** QAGOMA, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Check QAGOMA website (free/paid sections)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Source:** Broadsheet Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.broadsheet.com.au/brisbane/entertainment/article/whats-on-brisbane

Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson is known for his immersive installations drawing on water, light and air temperature. This Brisbane-exclusive exhibition delivers a multi-sensory journey celebrating his three-decade career, including *Riverbed* — a rocky landscape with running water — and *The Cubic Structural Evolution Project*, an all-white Lego city perpetually built and rebuilt.

---

### 7. 🖼️ Make A Scene – Queensland Museum Kurilpa
**Dates:** Until 19 July 2026 (running this week)
**Venue:** Queensland Museum Kurilpa, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Free
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Source:** The Urban List Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.theurbanlist.com/brisbane/a-list/whats-on-brisbane

Queensland Museum's latest free exhibition, *Make A Scene*, takes you back to an iconic era of Australian queer culture — a fashion-forward 90s showcase featuring colour, camp, pop culture and community, from fearless self-expressions of LGBTQIA+ identity to Brisbane-based labels that defined the era. Coinciding with the 35th anniversary of the decriminalisation of homosexuality, it's an immersive chance to engage with personal stories from the underground nightclub and dance party scene.

---

### 8. 🖼️ Precious — Museum of Brisbane
**Dates:** Ongoing (running this week)
**Venue:** Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane CBD
**Cost:** Free
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Source:** The Urban List Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.theurbanlist.com/brisbane/a-list/things-to-do-in-brisbane-this-weekend

*Precious* at Museum of Brisbane features more than 3,000 items loaned from around 30 incredible collections and collectors. With many on display for the first time, this charming assortment offers a glimpse into cherished collections usually hidden within suburban homes, covering the rare, beautiful and intriguing — from international dolls to ornamental eggs and wind-up toys.

---

### 9. 🌿 Redlands Coast AdventureFest
**Dates:** 15–24 May 2026 (starts this week)
**Venue:** Various locations, Redlands Coast (accessible from Brisbane)
**Cost:** Free / low cost (varies by activity)
**Category:** Community / Other (Outdoor & Adventure)
**Source:** Must Do Brisbane
**Ticket Link:** https://www.mustdobrisbane.com/whats-on

The Redlands Coast AdventureFest is an exciting 10-day festival showcasing a wide variety of citywide events and activities. Get ready to lace up your boots and hit the road, because the Redlands Coast AdventureFest is officially returning from May 15 to 24. Expect kayaking, hiking, cycling, nature tours and outdoor experiences — perfect for adventurous and nature-oriented attendees. Check redlands.qld.gov.au/adventurefest for the full schedule.

### 10. 🤖 Build with AI 3.0 – GDG Brisbane ⭐ *Top Pick*
**Date:** Friday, 15 May 2026 — 5:30 PM – 9:00 PM
**Venue:** The Precinct, Fortitude Valley
**Cost:** Free (register on Eventbrite)
**Category:** Public Lecture / Workshop
**Source:** Eventbrite / Meetup (GDG Brisbane)
**Ticket Link:** https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/build-with-ai-30-2026-gdg-brisbane-tickets-1987565006438

GDG Brisbane presents an evening of deep dives into the practical side of Generative AI and Data Engineering — moving beyond simple prompts to explore how industry leaders ensure AI outputs are reliable and how serverless agents can automate data mapping. Whether you're a developer working on LLMs or a data engineer looking to leverage Gemini, this session offers a mix of high-level strategy and hands-on workshop learning. The agenda: 5:30–6:00 PM check-in, food & networking; 6:00–6:45 PM talk by Wesley Volz on LLM evaluation & lessons from Atlassian RovoDev; 7:00–8:30 PM workshop on The Self-Curation Engine (Gemini + Cloud Run); 8:40–9:00 PM networking & closing conversations.

**Venue:** Wonderland Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed (check Eventbrite)
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Source:** Eventbrite
**Ticket Link:** https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/the-yellow-diary-live-in-brisbane-tickets-1669038502089

The Yellow Diary Australia Tour comes to Wonderland Brisbane on Friday, 15th May 2026. Doors open 7:00 PM, show starts 8:00 PM sharp, followed by an exclusive Bollywood Club Night after-party that will keep you dancing till late. ### 12. 🧺 Weaving is Healing Workshop
**Date:** Saturday, 16 May 2026 — 10:30 AM – 3:30 PM
**Venue:** Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens, Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed (Eventbrite — see page for price; direct deposit option available)
**Category:** Workshop / Class
**Source:** Eventbrite
**Ticket Link:** https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/weaving-is-healing-brisbane-may-2026-tickets-1984547702601

Weave a basketling in a ceremony-style immersive sharing and healing circle, using the Figure 8 coil weave technique which has roots in Africa and Europe. This in-person event takes place at Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens on Saturday 16th May 2026. A hands-on, reflective craft workshop in a beautiful natural setting — great for those drawn to slow-making, community ritual, and indigenous craft traditions.

### 13. 🎸 Endless Swarm – Body Hammering Australia Tour
**Date:** Sunday, 17 May 2026 — 6:00 PM – 9:30 PM
**Venue:** BackDock Arts, Fortitude Valley
**Cost:** Ticketed (check Eventbrite)
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Source:** Eventbrite
**Ticket Link:** https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/endless-swarm-body-hammering-australia-2026-brisbane-tickets-1984932121408

Scottish powerviolence band Endless Swarm make their long-awaited first descent into the Southern Hemisphere in May. Forged in Edinburgh's underground and sharpened on stages across Europe, Japan and the USA, the band has built a reputation since 2013 as one of the most ferocious live acts in the genre — blast-driven hardcore, grind-scarred riffs and venomous vocals in short, savage bursts. A raw, underground show at BackDock Arts, one of Brisbane's most authentic indie/punk venues.

**Category:** Community / Other

Queensland's biggest celebration of dogs returns to the Brisbane Showgrounds on Saturday 16 & Sunday 17 May 2026. Whether you're a proud dog parent, thinking about welcoming a new furry friend, or you just love being surrounded by happy, wagging tails, this is your weekend — meet hundreds of beautiful dogs across dozens of breeds, shop dog brands, and access breed showcase and adoption zones. A genuinely community-spirited outdoor event — lots of natural conversation and a mixed crowd of people who love animals.
